profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 15+ years of experience building high-performance .NET applications and enterprise solutions.
Currently, I lead development of a .NET 10 WPF application at Laser Techniques Company, processing datasets of over 250 million samples. My focus is on software architecture, numerical algorithms, and performance optimization, including reducing processing time by over 90% while maintaining smooth, real-time visualization.
Previously, I spent 14 years at Avanade, delivering .NET and Azure solutions across financial services, government, healthcare, and aerospace.
I enjoy tackling complex engineering challenges, modernizing legacy systems, and using AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality.
Based in Seattle, always open to connecting with fellow engineers and technology professionals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer for a new client-facing high-precision laser-based measurement and inspection systems for defense, aerospace, and energy customers — I own architecture decisions, run daily standups, and drive scoping and delivery planning for a team of 3.
• Architected a modular .NET 10 WPF application on MVVM, dependency injection, and the .NET Generic Host, cleanly separating presentation, application services, data processing, and testable domain layers 
• Cut end-to-end processing time by over 90% on datasets of up to 250M+ samples through controlled parallelism, memory pooling, allocation reduction, and cache-conscious processing 
• Built the core numerical stack: FFT-based Butterworth filtering, median filtering, spatial resampling, circular interpolation, harmonic correction, invalid-data repair, and cylindrical coordinate transformations 
• Delivered interactive scientific visualization in SciChart — 60 FPS interaction on 250M+ sample datasets via adaptive downsampling and resolution-aware rendering, with heatmaps, polar cross-sections, and synchronized navigation • Engineered reusable desktop infrastructure for localization, runtime language switching, validation, authentication, and background processing, cutting per-feature boilerplate by roughly 80% 
• Established the team's automated testing practice with xUnit, NSubstitute, AutoFixture, and FluentAssertions 
• Integrated AI coding agents into the engineering workflow, cutting implementation time by roughly 50% while reviewing all generated code for production suitability
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C# · .NET · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · XAML · MVVM · Software Design · Project Management · Azure DevOps Services · Performance Engineering

positions.title: Gap year
positions.description: Position eliminated in a company-wide restructuring. Used the time for self-directed study in AI-assisted development and modern .NET before returning to full-time engineering.

positions.title: Senior Consultatnt, Software Engineering
positions.description:
Enterprise .NET and Azure delivery across large-scale, security-controlled environments.
• Built event-driven Azure services in C#/.NET Core with Azure Functions, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, and Data Lake Storage, ingesting and standardizing high-volume external data feeds into a canonical form for downstream consumers 
• Delivered secure ASP.NET Core web applications (C#, TypeScript, SQL Server, Azure Web Apps) under strict compliance controls, shipped through Azure DevOps CI/CD 
• Modernized legacy WPF/XAML desktop software around MVVM, refactoring 10+ views and building reusable UI components; developed Dynamics 365 integrations that cut end-user wait time by nearly 50% 
• Designed and shipped C#/.NET Core REST APIs and microservices on Azure App Service in distributed, event-driven architectures 
• Took ownership of a failing legacy ASP.NET MVC analytics application and re-engineered it into a maintainable architecture under an aggressive deadline; guided 3 offshore engineers through follow-on work

positions.title: Analyst → Consultant
positions.description: Built production Windows client and ASP.NET applications, automated build and deployment workflows with PowerShell, designed performance and load testing suites, and delivered CRM integrations and SQL/reporting work. Supported business-critical production systems across a range of enterprise environments, adapting to varied architectures, security requirements, and delivery processes.
